exposure: intramuscular injection of Diprofos(r) (betamethasone dipropionate 5 mg/ml and betamethasone sodium phosphate 2 mg/ml) once plus intravenous hydration
cohort: The study included fifty pregnant patients admitted to Al-Shatby Maternity University Hospital with hyperemesis gravidarum, divided into two groups of twenty-five each.
finding: There were no statistically significant differences in blood chloride levels between the group treated with long-acting corticosteroids plus hydration and the group receiving only hydration, either before or after treatment.
